fx_writer.queue_wait: accepted put_nowait to consumer get return; includes scheduler delay
fx_writer.execution: consumer get return to next get call or consumer exit; includes handler, commit/publication/notifications/future handling and recovery where present; excludes idle queue get
fx_writer.phase: execution/dequeue phase; submission route retained separately
fx_writer.overhead: per accepted enqueue: timestamp + dictionary entry; per dequeue/execution: timestamps, dictionary lookup, counters and sample append; two actor-level contextvar scopes; no extra task, await, SQL, I/O, polling or profiler
fx_writer.comparability: same module loaded before/after; baseline actor absence is unavailable, never zero; SQL cursor observer applies equally to both
fx_writer.limits: execution is consumer service elapsed, not pure DB time; future outcomes are observed done/cancelled flags, HTTP results remain success authority; shutdown-drained commands lack dequeue timing

lock_query_elapsed_semantics: client cursor execution elapsed includes PostgreSQL execution, possible lock wait, and transport/scheduling; NOT pure lock-wait time
pg_lock_wait_semantics: pg_stat_activity Lock samples are observed wait states at 0.5s sampling; no exact per-query wait duration
